subject: English
learning_objectives: Identify nouns as names of people, places, animals, and things
Identify action words (verbs) as words that show what someone is doing
Distinguish between a naming word (noun) and an action word (verb) in simple sentences
Construct simple English sentences combining a noun and an action word (e.g. 'Birds fly', 'Rani reads')

vocabulary.meaning: The name of a person, place, animal, or thing (e.g., Boy, School, Dog, Pen).
A word that shows an action or movement (e.g., Jump, Sing, Read, Run).
vocabulary.example_sentence: The children run in the playground.

vocabulary.meaning: A group of words that makes complete sense.

introduction: Point to objects and people around the classroom: teacher, blackboard, desk, door, friend. Ask students: 'What are these? Everything has a name!' Then ask a student to stand up, jump, and smile: 'What are they doing? They are doing actions!' Today we explore naming words (Nouns) and doing words (Action Words).
teacher_activity: Create a two-column chart on the blackboard: 'Naming Words (Nouns)' and 'Action Words (Verbs)'.
Hold up picture cards (e.g., Cat, Doctor, River) and ask students to place them in the Naming Words column.
Act out different actions (miming sleeping, eating, writing) and ask students to name the action word.
Model sentence formation: 'The [Noun] [Action Word]' -> 'The frog jumps', 'The sun shines'.
student_activity: Identify 3 nouns on their desk and 2 actions they did in the morning.
Play 'Simon Says' with action words (e.g., 'Simon says jump', 'Simon says clap').
Match noun flashcards with appropriate action word cards (e.g., Bird -> Fly, Fish -> Swim).
Write 4 simple noun-action sentences in notebooks.

lesson_steps.title: Warm-up & Classroom Naming Game
lesson_steps.description: Name 5 classroom objects and 5 animals in English.

lesson_steps.title: Introduction to Naming Words (Nouns)
lesson_steps.description: Categorize nouns into Person, Place, Animal, and Thing with picture cards.

lesson_steps.title: Introduction to Action Words (Verbs)
lesson_steps.description: Demonstrate physical actions (Run, Dance, Write, Eat, Sleep) and connect to spelling.

lesson_steps.title: Sentence Building Practice
lesson_steps.description: Pair nouns with actions to make short 3-word sentences.

lesson_steps.title: Review & Exit Ticket
lesson_steps.description: Each student says one noun and one action word before line-up.

classroom_activities.description: A student mimes an action word silently. The rest of the class guesses the action word in English.
Half the class gets noun cards (e.g., Monkey), half gets action cards (e.g., Climbs). Students walk around to find their matching partner.

assessment_questions.question: Which of these is a Noun (naming word)? (A) Jump (B) Tiger (C) Sing
Find the Action Word in this sentence: 'The girl dances happily.'
Fill in the blank with a suitable action word: 'Birds _____ in the sky.'

homework.title: Grammar Explorer Fun
tasks: Find and write 4 nouns (things or family members) in your home.
Write 4 action words of things you like to do on Sundays.
Make 2 sentences combining a noun and an action word.
